11 June 2003  •  23 saal ke ho gayi! 🎉

✦ Dil se ek wish ✦

"Har khushi teri ho, Charu Didi —
aaj aur hamesha. 🌸"

Aaj tumhara din hai — aur koi chaand, koi sitara tumse zyada nahi chamakta aaj ke din. 🌙

Tum jahan bhi ho, jitni bhi mushkilein ho, ek cheez yaad rakho: tum kisi ke liye bohot important ho. Bahut pyaar milta hai tumhe. 💗

23 saal mubarak ho! May this year bring you laughter that fills every room, love that never fades, aur woh sab khushiyaan jo tum deserve karti ho. ✨

Happy Birthday, Didi. 🎂🎊
